subject: english
title: Unit 9 Mission App — Think Creatively and Critically
subtitle: Vocab Foundations + Be the Expert + Think · Pair · Share — the thermal photo and Stephon Alexander. 6 modules.

content: Read a thermal image and explain why the riders' legs are the brightest part.
Learn about Stephon Alexander, theoretical physicist and National Geographic Explorer.
Name three things about the science of fun you want to understand better, and how you will find out.
Evaluate a plan — decide whether it will actually work.
language: Use the academic words share and evaluate to talk about ideas.
Use unexpected, curious, thermal image, think creatively, think critically, and physicist in context.
Use the frame I want to understand ___ better. I will find out by ___.
